description: Hazard Map Portal Site (ハザードマップポータルサイト) is a data portal run by Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) and MLIT. The portal overlays official flood, storm-surge, tsunami and landslide hazard layers and links to the hazard maps of municipalities, together with evacuation-centre and disaster-history layers, and offers the layers as tiles and downloads through GSI and MLIT services. Coverage: Japan (nationwide). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as tiles, geotiff, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("ハザードマップポータルサイト") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support hazard exposure screening of buildings, roads and shelters in Japan. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
